# QnALog 1.6.5

## Highlights

- New **Topics** tab. Right-click an original minutes note and choose "Create topic" (创建成为主题): the plugin lists notes that share project or topic tags (checked by default) and notes with similar content (unchecked), and builds a topic page from the notes you keep.
- Topic pages are ordinary notes under `QnALog/主题/`: a short overview, progress threads with footnote sources, disagreements with a sourced side each, open questions and actions as tasks, a timeline and a source list. Source notes are never modified and the minutes list is unchanged.
- Updates are incremental and previewed first. Add a note through the minutes context menu ("Add to topic") or scan a topic for notes not yet included. Every update keeps a snapshot, and "Undo last update" restores it when the page has not changed afterwards.
- Topic pages use note overviews by default. Choosing note bodies shows a request estimate first.
- Joining a note places its timeline row and source footnote in their own sections in date order.
- Topic dialogs share one title bar, larger spacing, right-aligned source title and date, and a waiting dialog with cancel when a preview takes time.
- Browsing the minutes or topics list no longer switches the sidebar back to the outline; scroll position is kept and the current row follows the active file. Starting or finishing a recording still switches to the outline.

## User impact

The settings schema and API key storage are unchanged; no new settings keys. Existing notes are not modified. Topic generation sends note overviews (or, when chosen, note bodies) to the configured text model, so it uses the same quota as organizing a note. The browse-tab behavior is the only change to existing workflows.
